UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a student user's profile, containing personal details and virtual currency balance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: User's email address, used for remembering login. (Not for authentication storage)

age.description: The user's age, used to determine content difficulty and personalize learning.

virtualCurrencyBalance.description: The current balance of virtual money the user possesses for simulations and savings goals.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

progressDashboardId.description: Reference to the UserProgressDashboard associated with this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 UserProgressDashboard)

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Represents a single educational lesson covering a financial concept.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Lesson entity.

description.description: A brief summary of the lesson's content.

contentBody.description: The main content of the lesson, which could include text, simplified HTML, or markdown.

difficultyLevel.description: The target difficulty level for the lesson (e.g., simple, medium, normal).

category.description: The financial category the lesson belongs to (e.g., 'Income', 'Expenses', 'Savings', 'Investing').

flashcardIds.description: References to Flashcards associated with this lesson. (Relationship: Lesson N:N Flashcard)

Flashcard.title: Flashcard
Flashcard.description: Represents a single flashcard used for learning financial terms and definitions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Flashcard entity.

term.description: The financial term or concept on the front of the flashcard.

definition.description: The definition or explanation on the back of the flashcard.

difficultyLevel.description: The target difficulty level for the flashcard (e.g., simple, medium, normal).

lessonId.description: Reference to the Lesson this flashcard belongs to. (Relationship: Lesson 1:N Flashcard)

UserProgressDashboard.title: UserProgressDashboard
UserProgressDashboard.description: Aggregates a user's overall progress, investment performance, and savings achievements for display on the dashboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProgressDashboard entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this dashboard belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 UserProgressDashboard)

totalLessonsCompleted.description: The total count of lessons the user has completed.

totalFlashcardsMastered.description: The total count of flashcards the user has mastered.

totalVirtualProfitLoss.description: The total virtual profit or loss from market simulation investments.

totalSavingsAchieved.description: The total amount of virtual currency saved across all goals.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the user's progress dashboard.

LessonProgressRecord.title: LessonProgressRecord
LessonProgressRecord.description: Tracks a user's progress on a specific lesson.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LessonProgressRecord entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this progress record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N LessonProgressRecord)

lessonId.description: Reference to the Lesson being tracked. (Relationship: Lesson 1:N LessonProgressRecord)

status.description: The current status of the lesson for the user (e.g., 'not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed').

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the lesson was completed, if applicable.

lastAccessedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user accessed this lesson.

FlashcardMastery.title: FlashcardMastery
FlashcardMastery.description: Tracks a user's mastery level for a specific flashcard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FlashcardMastery entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who is learning this flashcard. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FlashcardMastery)

flashcardId.description: Reference to the Flashcard being mastered. (Relationship: Flashcard 1:N FlashcardMastery)

masteryLevel.description: A numerical representation of the user's mastery of the flashcard (e.g., 0-5, where 5 is fully mastered).

lastReviewedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user reviewed this flashcard.

correctAttempts.description: The number of times the user answered this flashcard correctly.

incorrectAttempts.description: The number of times the user answered this flashcard incorrectly.

VirtualCompany.title: VirtualCompany
VirtualCompany.description: Represents a fictional company in the virtual stock market simulation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VirtualCompany entity.

name.description: The name of the virtual company.

industry.description: The industry sector the company operates in (e.g., 'Tech', 'Energy', 'Retail').

description.description: A brief description of the virtual company and its business.

currentStockPrice.description: The current virtual stock price per share for this company.

logoUrl.description: URL to the company's logo graphic.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the virtual company was created in the simulation.

lastPriceUpdateAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the company's stock price.

VirtualStockPriceHistory.title: VirtualStockPriceHistory
VirtualStockPriceHistory.description: Records historical stock prices for a virtual company over time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VirtualStockPriceHistory entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the VirtualCompany whose stock price is being recorded. (Relationship: VirtualCompany 1:N VirtualStockPriceHistory)

timestamp.description: The date and time of the recorded stock price.

price.description: The stock price at the given timestamp.

simulatedNewsEventId.description: Optional reference to a SimulatedNewsEvent that influenced this price change. (Relationship: SimulatedNewsEvent 1:N VirtualStockPriceHistory)

SimulatedNewsEvent.title: SimulatedNewsEvent
SimulatedNewsEvent.description: Represents a simulated news event that impacts virtual stock prices and provides educational insights.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SimulatedNewsEvent entity.

headline.description: The headline of the simulated news event.

description.description: A detailed description of the news event.

impactFactor.description: A numerical factor indicating the magnitude and direction (positive/negative) of the impact on stock prices.

affectedCompanyIds.description: References to VirtualCompanies affected by this news event. (Relationship: SimulatedNewsEvent N:N VirtualCompany)

educationalPopupText.description: Text for an educational pop-up explaining the market concept related to this news event (e.g., volatility, supply/demand).

eventDate.description: The simulated date and time when the news event occurred.

UserVirtualInvestment.title: UserVirtualInvestment
UserVirtualInvestment.description: Records a user's virtual investment in a specific company's stock.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserVirtualInvestment entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile making the investment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserVirtualInvestment)

companyId.description: Reference to the VirtualCompany whose shares are owned. (Relationship: VirtualCompany 1:N UserVirtualInvestment)

sharesOwned.description: The number of shares of the virtual company owned by the user.

averagePurchasePricePerShare.description: The average price per share at which the user purchased the shares.

totalInvestmentAmount.description: The total virtual currency amount invested in these shares.

lastTransactionAt.description: Timestamp of the last transaction (buy or sell) affecting this investment.

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Allows users to set and track virtual savings goals.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SavingsGoal entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who set this savings goal. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N SavingsGoal)

goalName.description: A descriptive name for the savings goal (e.g., 'New Bike', 'Video Game').

description.description: A brief description of what the user is saving for.

targetAmount.description: The total virtual currency amount the user aims to save.

currentSavedAmount.description: The current amount of virtual currency saved towards the goal.

startDate.description: The date when the savings goal was initiated.

targetDate.description: The optional target date by which the user aims to achieve the goal.

isAchieved.description: Indicates whether the savings goal has been achieved.

achievedAt.description: Timestamp when the savings goal was achieved, if applicable.

VirtualTransaction.title: VirtualTransaction
VirtualTransaction.description: Records all virtual money movements made by a user within the app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VirtualTransaction entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who performed the transaction. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N VirtualTransaction)

amount.description: The amount of virtual currency involved in the transaction.

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

relatedEntityId.description: Optional reference to an entity related to this transaction (e.g., UserVirtualInvestment ID, SavingsGoal ID).

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

firestore.reasoning:
The proposed Firestore structure prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by strictly adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates. 

**Authorization Independence and Denormalization (Mandate A):**
For all user-specific data (UserProfile, UserProgressDashboard, LessonProgressRecord, FlashcardMastery, UserVirtualInvestment, SavingsGoal, VirtualTransaction), a hierarchical path based on the user's ID is used: `/users/{userId}/<subcollection>/<documentId>`. Crucially, for every document within these user-specific subcollections (e.g., `lessonProgress`, `flashcardMastery`, `virtualInvestments`), the `userId` is explicitly denormalized into the document itself (e.g., `LessonProgressRecord.userId`, `FlashcardMastery.userId`). This is a critical implementation of **Authorization Independence**. It allows Firestore Security Rules to authorize access by simply comparing `request.auth.uid` with `resource.data.userId`, eliminating the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents. This design ensures that atomic operations (transactions and batched writes) remain robust and secure, as rule evaluation for a child document does not depend on reading its parent.

**Querying and Authorization Posture (QAPs - Mandate B & C):**
1.  **User-Specific Data:** All user-owned data is stored in dedicated subcollections under `/users/{userId}/`. This creates a strong **Path-Based Ownership** model, making it trivial for security rules to ensure that a user can only access their own data (`request.auth.uid == userId`). `list` operations on these subcollections (e.g., `/users/{userId}/lessonProgress`) are inherently secure and efficient because the query is scoped to the authenticated user's ID, fulfilling QAPs without rules acting as filters.
2.  **Global/Public Content:** Entities like `Lesson`, `Flashcard`, `VirtualCompany`, and `SimulatedNewsEvent` represent shared educational content or simulation data. These are placed in top-level collections (e.g., `/lessons/{lessonId}`). This ensures a **Homogeneous Security Posture** (Mandate B): all documents within these collections share the same security requirements, typically read-only access for all authenticated users. `list` queries on these collections are secure and efficient as all documents are intended to be broadly accessible to authenticated users.
3.  **Nested Global Data:** `VirtualStockPriceHistory` is stored as a subcollection under `VirtualCompany` (`/virtualCompanies/{companyId}/priceHistory/{historyRecordId}`). Since `VirtualCompany` documents are globally readable, their subcollections also inherit this simple read access without requiring complex `get()` calls.

**Overall Benefits:**
The structure explicitly maps data ownership and access patterns, greatly simplifying security rule development. Rules will be concise, focusing on `request.auth.uid` checks for user-specific data and simple `allow read: if request.auth != null;` for global content. This approach minimizes complexity, enhances security, and ensures the scalability and debuggability of the Firestore application.
